limitations: Two downloaded video lessons (3215065 and 4733817) were not watched or transcribed in full; only text, metadata and thumbnails were reviewed.
One embedded external Googleusercontent image in step 3214901 could not be retrieved in the supplied export; its contents were not inspected.

Code-task source settings were read, but long test-case inputs/outputs were abbreviated during this agent's review. The parent agent independently reviews all code checkers/tests; that verification must be combined with this report.
Image review used nine contact sheets covering all 49 downloaded images, including two video thumbnails. There was no OCR-only substitution for visual review.
This is a static first pass plus focused minimal examples, not an execution of all complete course programs or a proof of absence of further errors.
MSVC-specific behaviour and old preprocessor extensions were not treated as universal standard C++ behaviour; Google Test one-argument issue is classified portability.
The restricted Roman numeral variant in 3496771 deliberately lacks D in its image; its nonstandard answer was not classified as a wrong key without the intended rules.
No changes were made to course source files or to GitHub.
